t: This is the Church of St Michael, known as St Michael's Highgate, an Anglican parish church and a Grade II star listed building. It is the highest elevated church in London. The architect Lewis Vulliamy designed it, and he came from a family of clockmakers. The poet Samuel Taylor Coleridge is buried here. He was a founder of the Romantic Movement in England and a member of the Lake Poets, alongside his friend William Wordsworth. So this hilltop church holds the grave of one of English poetry's most important figures.
